notes: growth_phase mid_exponential inferred for all (log phase at OD 0.3 in LB, sampled 1 h later, within the 2 h rule; untreated cultures may be past mid-log by then). lexA3 strains also carry the linked malG::Tn10 marker; labelled point_mutation in lexA. AZT (replication chain terminator) -> dna_damage, 1 h -> short. WT re-read: the rph+ MG1655 derivative STL18703 is called wild-type and carries no stated marker -> wild_type.
